title: Monthly review of accounts of Government of India for April 2026 (FY2026-27)
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Finance

Monthly review of accounts of Government of India for April 2026 (FY2026-27)

Posted On:
01 JUN 2026 8:25PM by PIB Delhi

The monthly account of the Government of India for April 2026 has been consolidated and reports published. The highlights are given below:-

The Government of India has received ₹2,12,679 crore (5.8% of corresponding BE 2026-27 of Total Receipts) for April 2026 comprising ₹1,78,492 crore Tax Revenue (Net to Centre), ₹24,293 crore of Non-Tax Revenue and ₹9,894 crore of Non-Debt Capital Receipts, on account of Recovery of Loans. ₹87,779 crore has been transferred to State Governments as Devolution of Share of Taxes by Government of India this period which is ₹6,044 crore higher than the previous year.

Total Expenditure incurred by Government of India is ₹5,74,892 crore (10.8% of corresponding BE 2026-27), out of which ₹3,85,151 crore is on Revenue Account and ₹1,89,831 crore is on Capital Account. Out of the Total Revenue Expenditure, ₹1,09,562 crore is on account of Interest Payments and ₹43,633 crore is on account of Major Subsidies.

****
